thread:
jordan: Quick catch - finance flagged a tenant where console shows ~30% of tokens billed to v2 even though their route is pinned to v1. Not a huge scale customer but annoying. Any ideas?

anika: Hmm. Do we have a repro? Could be the deprecation UX banner that triggers a silent header rewrite from some SDKs. If the header briefly advertises v2, the router might tag telemetry then swap back.

riley: I dug into traces. Pattern: client sends no version header -> router emits tentative 'v2_probe' tag -> pinned route (v1) answers. Our dashboard aggregates by ANY tag in interval which makes the chart include both.

omar: So the signal flow is: probe tag + final serve. Aggregation is OR-based rather than attribution-based. For quotas we should be using an attribution set, not an OR.

jordan: Right. Which means two options: change aggregation rules in the console (preferred UX-only change) OR fix upstream telemetry so each request has a single canonical billed_variant field.

anika: UX change is faster but risky: hides raw signals. I'd prefer canonical billed_variant in telemetry so billing and alerts are unambiguous. Console can still surface raw signals behind a toggle.

riley: Agreed. We should emit billed_variant and billed_tokens at ingest time. Also keep raw.tags for debugging.

omar: Proposed telemetry payload (as an example) in case it helps the infra folks:

```json
{
  "req_id": "r-9a1",
  "client_version_header": "", 
  "route_pin": "v1",
  "probe_tag": "v2_probe",
  "served_variant": "v1",
  "billed_variant": "v1",
  "billed_tokens": 123,
  "reason": "pin_precedence"
}
```

jordan: Nice. 'reason' should be enum: pin_precedence, fallback, proxy_swap, cache_hit. Keeps UI human-friendly.

anika: For rollout: 1) add fields in staging and write to a shadow timeseries namespace, 2) leave console queries unchanged but add "billing.tokens.attributed" as a hidden candidate metric, 3) run 14-day compare job to catch >1% delta per-tenant, 4) if safe, flip billing and console default.

riley: Also add a console banner explaining the change and a small FAQ link. Tenants seeing >3% delta should get an email from finance before flip.

omar: Implementation detail: pipeline transform must be idempotent and resilient to partial events. If billed_tokens not present, consumers will fallback to raw.token_sum. Add a schema version field so we can backfill.

jordan: Can billing pipeline support a safe fallback? billing-bot?

billing-bot: billing-check: Yes. Billing job can prefer billed_tokens but will fallback to raw.tokens_sum when billed_tokens missing. Would like a plan to detect diverging numbers before switch.

anika: I can write a small job 'compare_billed_vs_raw.py' that flags tenants with >1% diff and outputs a sample list. We'll run it during shadow period.

riley: UX mock: console top-right will have a toggle 'Show attribution mode: Attributed (default) / Raw'. When hovered: 'Attributed shows tokens assigned to the variant that produced the final output. Raw shows all emitted routing tags.'

omar: For deprecation banners: they should not cause SDKs to rewrite headers automatically. If SDKs need to probe, they must set an explicit probe flag so telemetry can record probe intent.

jordan: Good call. Add a 'probe_intent' boolean to telemetry if the client sent a probe.

anika: Action items: Anika - telemetry PR (adds billed_variant, billed_tokens, reason, probe_intent, schema_version). Riley - console mock + FAQ copy. Omar - pipeline transform + shadow namespace. Jordan - coordinate finance notif and the 14-day plan.

anika: Estimated timeline: PR this week, staging ingestion next week, 14-day collection after that, then review with finance.

riley: I'll prepare the banner copy: 'You're on v1 — deprecated. Your requests continue to be served but we will sunset v1 on YYYY-MM-DD. Learn more.' Link to migration guide.

billing-bot: noted. Will watch the compare job output and auto-open a ticket to #finance if >5 tenants exceed 3% delta.

omar: One more edge case: edge caches that serve from a warm v2 slot even if final_variant is v1 in the trace. Need to ensure final_variant is authoritative. Pipeline must prefer final_variant and ignore intermediate cache hits when computing billed_variant.

anika: We'll make final_variant authoritative and add attribution_reason 'final_served' vs 'intermediate_cache'.

jordan: Great. If nobody objects I'll file RFC and schedule a short sync. :+1:

riley: No objections. Filing an internal follow-up in #eng-platform with links to the mock and PRs once ready.

anika: Thanks. Starting PR now.

jordan: Thanks team.
